newsitem.title: USA: Intel to unveil 300-Mhz chip Friday.
newsitem.headline: Intel to unveil 300-Mhz chip Friday.

text.p: Intel Corp on Friday will unveil a computer chip that is 50 percent faster than its top-of-the-line Pentium Pro microprocessor, a company spokesman said.

The world's biggest chipmaker will demonstrate a 300-megahertz microprocessor at the International Solid State Circuits Conference being held this week in San Francisco, where electrical engineers from the semiconductor industry show off their latest technology.
The Intel chip will appear in personal computers later this year, said spokesman Howard High.
The fastest Intel chip in production now is the 200-Mhz Pentium Pro.

Megahertz measures the chip's so-called clock speed, or the number of times per second the chip can update the computer's calculations and operations. Generally, the higher the megahertz rating, the faster a chip can calculate.
